findings.title: IAM role has no permissions boundary
findings.description: The role sets no permissions_boundary, so nothing caps the maximum permissions its policies can grant — a single overly broad policy attachment becomes fully effective. Set a permissions boundary as a guardrail.
findings.remediation: Apply least privilege. Replace wildcard (`*`) actions and resources with the minimum scoped ARNs the workload needs. Split policy authoring from attachment. Use IAM Access Analyzer to generate scoped policies from CloudTrail history.

findings.title: IAM role has no description
findings.description: The IAM role has no description, so reviewers cannot tell what the role is for or who owns it. Document the role's purpose in the description field.
findings.remediation: Apply least privilege. Replace wildcard (`*`) actions and resources with the minimum scoped ARNs the workload needs. Split policy authoring from attachment. Use IAM Access Analyzer to generate scoped policies from CloudTrail history.
